name: 2D Video Editing Studio
description: Master Autonomous 2D Video Director & Production Engine: Broadcast-quality Vox explainers, stickman animations, doodle sketchbooks, crime documentary thrillers, and 8-bit retro arcade videos with rapid Google Flow parallel asset dispatch.
author: Dipesh Kr Yadav

mcp_tools.name: studio_status
mcp_tools.description: Check 2D Video Editing Studio status, available visual styles (Vox, Stickman, Doodle, Noir, Arcade), audio mix capabilities, and connected engines.

mcp_tools.name: studio_list_styles
mcp_tools.description: List all 8 supported visual style engines, design motifs, and editorial recipes.

style.description: Optional specific style name to inspect recipes for (e.g. documentary, stickman, noir, arcade, doodle, sticker).

mcp_tools.name: studio_plan_project
mcp_tools.description: Generate an editorial shot list and visual asset breakdown for a video script based on style and timing.

topic.description: Topic or title of the video project.

style.description: Visual style: documentary, stickman, doodle, noir, arcade, or sticker.

aspect.description: Aspect ratio (vertical 9:16 for Shorts/Reels, or 16:9 landscape).

mcp_tools.name: studio_render_command
mcp_tools.description: Get the precise CLI render commands to preview or produce master video on device (Termux/Linux/Desktop).

preview_only.description: Whether to generate a fast 540p draft preview instead of 1080p master render.
